+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import requests
+
+
+ASSEMBLYAI_BASE_URL = "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2"
+
+
+def submit_audio(audio_path: str, api_key: str) -> str:
+    headers = {"authorization": api_key}
+    with open(audio_path, "rb") as f:
+        upload = requests.post(
+            f"{ASSEMBLYAI_BASE_URL}/upload",
+            headers=headers,
+            data=f,
+            timeout=120,
+        )
+    upload.raise_for_status()
+    return upload.json()["upload_url"]
+
+
+def create_transcript(upload_url: str, api_key: str) -> str:
+    headers = {"authorization": api_key, "content-type": "application/json"}
+    payload = {"audio_url": upload_url, "speaker_labels": True}
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"{ASSEMBLYAI_BASE_URL}/transcript",
+        headers=headers,
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=120,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()["id"]
+
+
+def poll_transcript(transcript_id: str, api_key: str) -> dict:
+    headers = {"authorization": api_key}
+    while True:
+        response = requests.get(
+            f"{ASSEMBLYAI_BASE_URL}/transcript/{transcript_id}",
+            headers=headers,
+            timeout=120,
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        data = response.json()
+        status = data.get("status")
+        if status == "completed":
+            return data
+        if status == "error":
+            raise RuntimeError(data.get("error", "AssemblyAI transcription failed"))
+        time.sleep(5)
+
+
+def format_diarized_transcript(data: dict) -> str:
+    utterances = data.get("utterances") or []
+    if utterances:
+        lines = []
+        for item in utterances:
+            speaker = item.get("speaker", "Unknown")
+            text = item.get("text", "").strip()
+            if text:
+                lines.append(f"Speaker {speaker}: {text}")
+        return "\n".join(lines)
+    text = data.get("text", "")
+    return text
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Request speaker diarization for a recorded meeting using AssemblyAI.")
+    parser.add_argument("audio_file", help="Path to the recorded meeting audio file")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    api_key = os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        print("Missing ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY environment variable", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    audio_path = Path(args.audio_file)
+    if not audio_path.is_file():
+        print(f"Audio file not found: {audio_path}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    upload_url = submit_audio(str(audio_path), api_key)
+    transcript_id = create_transcript(upload_url, api_key)
+    transcript = poll_transcript(transcript_id, api_key)
+    print(format_diarized_transcript(transcript))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch

+import os
+import time
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+ASSEMBLYAI_API_BASE = "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2"
+
+
+def poll_transcription(job_id: str, poll_interval: float = 2.0, timeout: Optional[float] = None) -> str:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    headers = {"authorization": api_key}
+    start = time.monotonic()
+
+    while True:
+        response = requests.get(f"{ASSEMBLYAI_API_BASE}/transcript/{job_id}", headers=headers, timeout=30)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        data: Dict[str, Any] = response.json()
+        status = data.get("status")
+
+        if status == "completed":
+            transcript = data.get("text")
+            if not transcript:
+                raise RuntimeError("Transcription completed but no transcript text was returned")
+            return transcript
+
+        if status == "error":
+            raise RuntimeError(data.get("error", "Transcription failed"))
+
+        if timeout is not None and (time.monotonic() - start) >= timeout:
+            raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for transcription to complete")
+
+        time.sleep(poll_interval)
*** End Patch

+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def submit_batch_transcription(audio_path: str) -> str:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    with open(audio_path, "rb") as audio_file:
+        result = client.audio.transcriptions.create(
+            model="gpt-4o-mini-transcribe",
+            file=audio_file,
+        )
+    return result.text
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("audio_path")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    try:
+        text = submit_batch_transcription(args.audio_path)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    print(text)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
